visualReview.notes: Actually inspected 83 final images: 14 portable, 14 shared, 30 medium-fi and 25 normal terrain views. Compared west round cone, steep keep roof/scallops, open timber belfry, east projected square tower, south stair turret and entrance with the inspected 2023 exterior photograph. Compared courtyard lower arches, upper timber gallery, well ironwork and roof continuity with the inspected 2012 courtyard photograph. Repaired missing white upper-gallery infill, retaining windows and lower open arches. Replaced the old provisional four-meter rock platform with occupied mapped feet on retained terrain; court paving is a separate thin architectural slab. The official visitor plan confirms courtyard/well and southwest entrance topology. Window rhythms, gallery subdivisions, roof curves and carved details remain reconstructed.

sharedSurfaceReview.notes: Six canonical graphs: granite, limestone, lime plaster, timber, painted metal and ceramic tile. Carved stone shares tinted limestone; dark recesses share tinted plaster; glass uses opaque local PBR. Skyline bakes common linear material means into one draw. All six current GLBs have zero embedded images. Actual shared renders show plaster, tile, masonry and wood consistently; the fixture reads each graph once and releases model geometries on unload. Its flat stage is material/placement evidence only, not actual rocky-hill contact. No reference pixels were copied into textures.

mediumFiReview.notes: All 30 final medium-fi frames actually inspected: noon/late light, economy/high quality, nine architecture cameras, four whole-castle LOD views and transitions. District retains both conical towers, stepped roofs, open belfry, projected east chamber, mapped feet and courtyard arches at 2504 triangles. Street adds smaller openings and roof/masonry groups at 4424 triangles. Close-up retains clipped roof-tile relief, timber framing, well ironwork, stairs and window trim at 33258 triangles. Skyline keeps the castle composition, enclosed upper gallery and open lower arches at 786 triangles; small windows, stair treads and well ironwork fade. All levels keep the roofless court. Synthetic outer buildings are not actual village evidence; independent normal placement tests the retained terrain.

geographicReview.notes: Fresh OSM relation 3300200 v30 has exact Q390275 identity. Seven outer/court/tower ways agree with retained native coordinates within 0.672 mm. Native +X points southeast at 129.515 degrees and +Z southwest at 219.515 degrees. West round tower, northeast keep/belfry, eastern square tower and southwest entrance sign heading -0.689652279939 rad at [25.367082771,45.515080804]. No mirroring/rescaling. Retained public Terrarium numeric tiles produce 4225 native heights at 4 m spacing over a 256 m window. Y0 is decoded anchor working datum 764.9841 m, not a surveyed regional or ellipsoidal datum. The reconstructed court floor is 3.849 m above anchor, using highest mapped exterior-boundary sample plus 0.25 m. One rigid -0.151 m translation preserves architectural proportions; occupied feet extend 4 m below sampled grade. Thin court paving is architectural. Host terrain supplies the geological knoll; whole-precinct replacement/cutout remains disabled.

fidelityReview.notes: Accepted medium-fi exterior reconstruction. Original 145600-triangle, 13770396-byte master is exactly reproducible at sha256:1d40b097ab6f1765fa729f7b06db09811704bac68fee1c3ed384422ff4987bff from unchanged bran-castle-model.mjs#branStudy.build. The independent derivative retains evidence-guided relative roof/tower proportions. OSM height tags 50–73 m have unresolved datum and are not facade survey values. Terrarium tile spacing and native review sampling do not establish source DEM resolution or vertical accuracy; this product smooths the small rocky cliff and may include vegetation/building contamination. Romanian public terrain service was unreachable. Exact floor/steps, cliff profile, roof-tile shapes, weathering and carving remain approximations. Interior rooms/artworks, underground Time Tunnel, park, village and temporary visitor equipment are omitted. No universal host-terrain or physical-device timing claim.

legacyFidelityScope.notes: Maximum fidelity remains pending: mapped horizontal layout is retained but measured elevations, roof valleys and obscured window positions require refinement. OSM height tags from 50 to 73 m have an unresolved common datum. The authored local heights are photographic estimates, not a survey. The courtyard gallery, well ironwork, scalloped keep parapet, entrance portal, chimneys and window rhythms use photographic proportions. Interior rooms, artworks and furniture are outside this exterior asset. The four-meter rock contact is not the full hill. Park, forest, approach paths and terrain fitting remain separate. Shared procedural plaster, stone, timber, ceramic tile and metal avoid embedded images. Plaster weathering and the distinctive rounded tile pattern need further material-specific refinement.
legacyFidelityScope.reviewBinding: Historical record only; current approval is the newly inspected medium-fi scope.

geometryValidation.notes: Three focused tests pass: original master bytes reproduce independently; current source/runtime and retained terrain hashes agree; exact identity and signed map-frame helper accept the evidence. All four browser levels retain open court and gallery arches. Mapped perimeter probes require outward front faces, matching the browser renderer, with occupied feet buried below sampled terrain. Fresh child-process LOD builds reproduce exact bytes within 1000/4000/16000/64000 triangle and eight-draw budgets and 3 MB initial download. POSITION/NORMAL use separate 12-byte streams. Six GLBs pass Khronos with zero errors, warnings and embedded images; strict medium-fi findings are empty. Normal placement verifies terrain reference, three open-ground probes within 0.08 m, mapped foundation faces and lower gallery arch at all levels; five unloads release model geometries and restore ground. These are sampled geometry/contact checks, not an architectural survey or exhaustive manifold certification.

limitations: Original 145600-triangle / 13770396-byte master remains preserved and reproducible at sha256:1d40b097ab6f1765fa729f7b06db09811704bac68fee1c3ed384422ff4987bff from bran-castle-model.mjs#branStudy.build. Independent medium-fi derivative retains the exterior while replacing the provisional four-meter rock contact with mapped feet and an explicit relative terrain reference.

Fresh exact-Q390275 relation 3300200 v30 and seven outer, court and roof/tower ways match retained coordinates within 0.672 mm. Native +X southeast at 129.515 degrees, +Z southwest at 219.515 degrees. Round western tower, northeast keep/belfry, eastern tower and southwest stair/entrance sign the frame. Retained Terrarium public numeric terrain and a 4225-value 4 m native grid establish contact against one viewer terrain product. Y0 is the decoded 764.9841 m anchor working datum; no regional survey or ellipsoid conversion is asserted. Reconstructed courtyard floor 3.849 m above that datum uses highest mapped outer-boundary sample plus 0.25 m. Architecture receives one rigid -0.151 m translation from the original court basis; footprints and vertical proportions remain intact. Occupied perimeter feet extend 4 m below sampled terrain, court paving stays a thin architectural slab, and host terrain supplies the geological knoll. Whole-precinct replacement/cutout remains disabled. Coarse terrain cannot establish precise cliff or architectural elevations; local Romanian public terrain service was unreachable.
OSM height tags 50–73 m have unresolved datum and are not facade survey heights. Keep roof, belfry, tower eaves, scallops and roof valley heights retain photograph-derived relative proportions.

Terrarium tile pixels and 4 m native review samples are not source DEM resolution or vertical accuracy. Small cliff, steps and under-building ground can be smoothed or contaminated; no local LiDAR accuracy, current terrain vintage or universal host compatibility claim.

Shared granite, limestone, plaster, timber, ceramic and painted-metal graphs; recesses share tinted plaster. Local opaque PBR glass and baked common skyline means avoid embedded images. Fine weathering and distinctive rounded tile ends are simplified.

Current exterior/courtyard reconstruction excludes interior rooms, artwork, furniture, underground Time Tunnel, temporary visitor equipment, surrounding park/forest and village. Courtyard masonry, gallery, well ironwork and window locations remain photograph-guided approximations. Physical phone/laptop timings remain unmeasured.

terrainReview.notes: Actually inspected all 25 final normal-placement images: five cameras for source plus four browser levels. Signed heading and retained terrainReference give zero model-origin elevation within 0.1 mm against the working native grid. Three open-ground probes differ by about 0.015 m from triangulated ground. Foundation front faces and open lower-gallery passage pass at every level; five unloads restore terrain and leave zero model geometries. The rocky cliff and exact floor/stair profiles are smoothed or photograph-guided, not surveyed. Retained Terrarium numeric images are height data, not model textures. Mapzen/underlying-provider and OSM attribution remain explicit.
